name: Zoe
source:
One half of an infamous duo. 

She works as a hostess alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c163090]Amelia[/url], pretending to be her twin in order to lure more customers. Years ago, she and her "sister" were arrested in connection with a series of serial killings. However, someone convinced the police to drop the charges, and they were released. Despite this incident, Zoe and Amelia didn't lose clients because their charm is too strong to be damaged by a wrongful arrest. It was a wrongful arrest, right?

Although they are not real sisters, Zoe shares a deep bond with Amelia and usually follows her lead. She seems to be more meek than her sister, though both are arrogant and cruel.
